source_refs.note: 3. Elliptical Polarization: a main subheading of 8.2 Types of polarization, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 176-176.

blocks.text: Linear aur circular polarization ka mel, jis mein electric field vector ka sira ellipse (anda jaisi golai) banata hai, elliptical polarization kehlata hai. Is mein (Fig. 8.4(c)) electric field ke do components Eₓ aur E_y barabar nahi hote aur/ya un ke phase mein kisi bhi angle θ ka farq hota hai. Misal: stress plate ya waveplate se guzarne wali light.

blocks.alt: x aur y axes ke milne ki jagah par centre (markaz) wala tirchha ellipse. Centre se kaale teer E_x (x ke saath) aur E_y (y ke saath). Lambi axis par cyan lakeer a, chhoti axis par magenta lakeer b, aur y axis se lambi axis tak khamdaar teer theta.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.4 (c): Light ki elliptical polarization (kitab ki Figure 8.4 (c) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: E ka sira daire ki bajaye ellipse par ghoomta hai kyun ke Eₓ aur E_y barabar nahi aur/ya un ke phase mein farq hai. a aur b ellipse ki aadhi lambi aur aadhi chhoti axes hain. Figure mein θ y-axis se ellipse ke tilt (jhukao) ka angle dikhata hai; text wala phase ka farq waqt ka farq hai, kaghaz par bana angle nahi, magar ellipse ka tilt isi phase farq aur Eₓ, E_y par depend karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Plane polarized aur circularly polarized light ke kuch istemal likhein (constructed response 8.1).
blocks.explanation: Plane polarized light: glare (chamak) kam karne wale polarized sunglasses aur camera filters, LCD screens, polarizer-analyzer se polarization pehchanna, optical activity se sugar solution (cheeni ke mehlool) ki concentration napna, aur materials ka stress analysis. Circular (aur elliptical) polarization tab banti hai jab light CD ya DVD jaisi surface se reflect ho ya stress plate ya waveplate se guzre; light ki polarization optical communication aur astronomy mein bhi istemal hoti hai.

items: Linear: E ek plane mein (polarizing filter, sunglasses). Circular: E clockwise (right-handed) ya counterclockwise (left-handed) ghoomta hai (CD/DVD se reflection). Elliptical: E ellipse banata hai; Eₓ aur E_y barabar nahi aur/ya phase mein θ ka farq (stress plate, waveplate).
